biography: Alec Poole, a name synonymous with both brilliance and baffling inconsistency in the world of motorsport, hails from the windswept coast of County Donegal, Ireland. Born into a family of sheep farmers, Alec's early life was far removed from the roar of engines. His introduction to racing came unexpectedly when a local rally team needed a last-minute co-driver; young Alec, known for his uncanny sense of direction, filled the role and found himself instantly hooked. He started his racing career in local rallycross events, using a beat-up Ford Escort he'd painstakingly restored. After a few seasons showing promise, the MINI Cooper S team discovered him and he transitioned to the world of circuit racing. Despite flashes of undeniable talent, Alec's career has been a rollercoaster. He's known for pulling off stunning overtakes one race, only to crash out inexplicably the next. Now, at 38, Alec continues to race, driven by the unwavering belief that he can finally unlock his full potential and silence the critics.
drivingStyle: Poole's driving style is often described as 'seat-of-his-pants' racing. He possesses an uncanny ability to feel the limit of grip, allowing him to push the car to its absolute edge – sometimes even beyond it. He's known for late-braking maneuvers that leave spectators gasping and competitors fuming. Tire management, however, isn't his strongest suit; he tends to overdrive the car early in the race, leaving him vulnerable in the closing laps. Under pressure, Alec can either rise to the occasion with a stunning performance, or completely crumble, making him a frustrating enigma for his team.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision in the 2018 Oulton Park race. Bellini accused Poole of reckless driving, and the two have exchanged barbs both on and off the track ever since.
Dubois, a rising star in the sport, consistently outperforms Poole, often leading to on-track clashes as Alec attempts to prove himself against the younger driver.
Tanaka is Poole's teammate and a constant source of irritation, as Kenji's calm, calculated approach to racing contrasts sharply with Poole's aggressive, impulsive style.

quirks: Always wears a pair of lucky shamrock socks, even in the hottest weather.
Refuses to start a race without listening to a specific Irish folk song.
Has a habit of talking to his car before each session, offering words of encouragement (or sometimes, stern warnings).
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about perfection; it's about controlled chaos. And sometimes, you just have to embrace the chaos."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2016 Brands Hatch Indy Circuit race in torrential rain. After starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying mishap, Alec carved his way through the field with a series of daring overtakes, showcasing his exceptional car control in treacherous conditions.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2019 Silverstone race. A mechanical failure, exacerbated by Alec's aggressive driving style, sent him spinning into the barriers, costing him a potential victory and severely damaging his championship hopes.
